tools.name: latvia_calendar_statistics
tools.description: Count working days, weekend days, holidays and total days off in 2026 or 2027 for a Monday-to-Friday week. Use it for yearly totals, such as how many working days a year has; for the holiday dates use latvia_holidays, and for leave suggestions use latvia_plan_time_off. year must be 2026 or 2027. app

tools.name: latvia_holidays
tools.description: List Latvia's public holidays in 2026 or 2027, sorted by date, each with its Latvian and English name. tools.name: latvia_leave_entitlement
tools.description: Estimate annual paid leave under the Latvian Labour Law, in calendar days excluding public holidays. Use it to answer how much leave someone has in a year; to find when to take it use latvia_plan_time_off, which counts leave in working days, a different unit. Pass annual_base=28 (the legal minimum)

tools.name: latvia_plan_time_off
tools.description: Suggest up to ten long breaks in 2026 or 2027, best first, where a few leave days bridge weekends and Latvian holidays.
